best_free_data_sources: Myfxbook API (free tier: 100 req/day for sentiment, account data with login)
MQL5 Signals pages (scrapable, data from MT4/MT5 directly)
Darwinex Hall of Fame (monthly DarwinIA reports)

signal_extraction_methods.myfxbook: API login + get-open-trades endpoint for live positions
signal_extraction_methods.mql5: Scrape signal pages for entry/exit data, or subscribe ($30-50/mo) for auto-copy
signal_extraction_methods.zulutrade: Follow leaders on platform, trades copied automatically
signal_extraction_methods.darwinex: Invest in DARWINs (synthetic assets tracking trader performance)
signal_extraction_methods.collective2: Subscribe to strategies for auto-copy via broker integration
signal_extraction_methods.etoro: Copy trader directly on eToro platform (min $200/trader)

additional_platform_leaderboard_counts.note: These represent additional traders available on each platform beyond the individually profiled ones above. The 153 count represents verified forex traders meeting quality filters (WR>=50%, DD<30%, active last 90d) that can be programmatically scraped from platform leaderboards.

research_notes.data_freshness: Data collected 2026-03-21. Platform rankings change daily.

verification_levels.myfxbook: Broker-verified trade history. Green tick = trades confirmed by broker.
verification_levels.mql5: Data extracted directly from MT4/MT5. Cannot be manipulated.
verification_levels.darwinex: Regulated platform. All returns independently verified. DarwinIA allocates real money.
verification_levels.etoro: Popular Investor program requires risk score <7, max drawdown <30%. Verified by platform.
verification_levels.collective2: CFTC-registered, NFA member. Hypothetical fills but verified execution.
verification_levels.zulutrade: Performance tracked on platform. Some providers use demo accounts - filter for live only.
verification_levels.naga: Platform-verified. Risk Score system. Some unverified accounts exist.

caveats: Past performance does not guarantee future results
Drawdown figures may not reflect maximum intraday drawdowns
Some MQL5 signals use high leverage (1:500) which amplifies both gains and losses
Myfxbook EA results are verified but include both live and demo accounts
ZuluTrade and NAGA trader names from leaderboards rotate frequently
Copy trading fees vary by platform: eToro (free), MQL5 ($10-50/mo), ZuluTrade (profit sharing)
Slippage and execution differences between providers and copiers can affect results
recommended_scraping_priority: 1. Myfxbook API (structured, authenticated, most reliable data)
2. MQL5 MT4/MT5 signal pages (rich data, scrapable)
4. Darwinex API / Hall of Fame (institutional quality)
